planets.name: Kepler-90 e
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-90 with a 91.9-day year, found in 2013.

text.card: Kepler-90 e was found in 2013 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 8 planets known around Kepler-90. Its orbit and size follow Cabrera et al. 2014's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname CABRERA_ET_AL__2014): disc_year 2013, disc_facility Kepler, sy_pnum 8; pl_orbper 91.93933735, pl_radj 0.237, pl_bmassj 0.0238

quotes.title: Kepler-90e
quotes.card: Kepler-90e is an exoplanet orbiting the star Kepler-90, located in the constellation Draco.
quotes.introduction: It was discovered by the Kepler telescope in October 2013.
